title: Finite-field trace as a sum of Frobenius powers
statement: Let $K\subseteq L$ be an extension of fields [def-weil-field, def-pc-field-extension], with $L$ finite as a set. Put $Q=\#K$ and $n=\dim_K L$. For $x\in L$, let $\operatorname{Tr}_{L/K}(x)\in K$ be the trace [def-weil-endomorphism-trace] of the $K$-linear endomorphism $m_x:L\to L$, $z\mapsto xz$. With $\iota:K\hookrightarrow L$ the structure embedding, one has $$\iota(\operatorname{Tr}_{L/K}(x))=\sum_{i=0}^{n-1}x^{Q^i}.$$

The hypotheses are Field K, Field L, Finite L and Algebra K L. The injective structure map makes K finite, and L is finite-dimensional over K. Q and n in the statement are exactly Nat.card K and Module.finrank K L.
